name: Sewlore Measurement Check
summary: Convert cm, mm and inches and record two-axis print-square errors offline, with optional CSV export.
description: Sewlore Measurement Check is an offline toolbar calculator for sewing measurement records. Convert a length between millimetres, centimetres and inches. Enter the target side, measured width and measured height of a printed test square to see signed axis errors and the gap between axes. Two separate flags compare your measurements with an editable working threshold; the threshold is not an industry standard. Export the entered values and available numeric results as a local CSV file. The tool does not assess fabric quality, fit or compliance and does not recommend one printer correction for unequal axes. No account, website access, telemetry or automatic network request is required. Inputs exist only while the popup is open and clear when it closes. Optional documentation links open only if clicked.
developer_account_note: Publisher must use the actual authenticated AMO account; no account handle or credentials are inferred.
price: Free; no paid functionality or account requirement
privacy_statement: The extension does not collect, transmit or sell personal data, browsing data or measurement entries. It has no analytics, advertising, login, cookies, browser storage or automatic network requests. Values and labels exist only in the open popup's memory and clear when it closes. A user-initiated CSV export creates a local file controlled by the user. Documentation opens only when clicked; measurement values and labels are never included in the link.
reviewer_notes: No test account or credentials are needed. Calculations work offline. 1 in converts to 25.4 mm and 2.54 cm. For target 100, measured X 99.6, measured Y 100.4 and threshold 0.5: errors are approximately -0.4%/+0.4%, gap 0.8 percentage points, both-axis-within Yes, axis-gap-exceeds Yes. For X=Y=98 with target 100: zero gap but both-axis-within No. Changing an input invalidates the displayed snapshot and disables CSV export until recalculation. Labels beginning with formula-like characters are apostrophe-prefixed in CSV. Source is readable and unbundled. A single optional Sewlore documentation anchor does not receive input data.
